description: RAG-HPO phenotype extraction: each model is the LLM inside RAG-HPO; output HPO codes are scored per document against expert annotations.

id68.label: ID-68
id68.about: 12 hand-picked clinical notes from ID-68 (families with intellectual disability, Anazi et al. 2017): 7 with seizures or epilepsy, 5 with negated findings, the rest other neurodevelopmental features.

gscplus.label: GSC+
gscplus.about: 12 hand-picked PubMed abstracts from GSC+ (Lobo et al. 2017): 8 on seizure or epilepsy disorders, 4 on other neurodevelopmental disorders.

selection_rule: Picked for the lab's use case (epilepsy and neurodevelopmental disorders): documents up to 350 words with at least 3 gold HPO codes; ID-68 takes the notes with negated findings first, then the notes with the most nervous-system findings; GSC+ takes 8 seizure/epilepsy abstracts and 4 other neurodevelopmental ones.
